rules: IDs are namespaced by provider and storefront where applicable
A title/artist string is not a stable recording identity
Changing tracks invalidates pending source requests immediately
Simultaneous cues are allowed
Translations reference original cue ID; duplicate timestamps alone do not prove translation

fields.displayHoldUntilMS: Int64?; computed UI policy, never written back as source time
fields.text: Exact source text, including intentional spaces

rules: No equal division of a line to fabricate token times
If end is unknown, activate at actual start without claiming measured continuous word duration
Preserve ligature/grapheme/RTL shaping; map logical ranges to actual glyph runs
Pause is orthogonal to lyric availability
Interlude requires known timing gap, or conservative waiting state for LRC
404 never means instrumental
Hide old lyrics immediately on recording-generation change
Manual scroll freezes automatic alignment until explicit resume or documented timeout
Only extrapolate from trusted real position while playing
Pause freezes; seek and new recording rebase immediately
Wake/reconnect requires fresh state
Do not integrate frame deltas
Output-device latency adjustment is separate from source lyric offset
Identity correctness precedes word timing or translation quality
Do not strip all version tags or assume absent tag means studio
Known duration differences >5000 ms cannot auto-apply metadata-only match
<=2000 ms is a preferred gate, not evidence of unique identity
All async responses must match current generation

ttml.scope: Apple/AMLL lyric profile with validated common TTML time expressions

lyricsfile.offsetPolicy: Preserve unresolved offset_ms diagnostically; do not apply a guessed sign

rules: User binding and adjustment outrank network refresh
Do not persist invented source end times
Keep immutable raw content separate from normalized display model
Refresh via ETag or source revision
Do not download full corpus on song changes

implementation.preferred: Swift domain + Foundation XMLParser + AppKit/Core Text rendering
licensedReuse: MIT Lyrics-Plus matching features with attribution
MIT ttml-processor-rs semantic port as required
excluded: AGPL AMLL code copied into closed combined app
